author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: VSA 9.5 has no syslog or webhook export for these logs, so collectors/kaseya-vsa95-data-warehouse pulls five Data Warehouse API datasets (RemoteControlSessions, RemoteControlFileTransferSessions, AgentLiveConnectAuditLogs, LiveConnectOnDemandAudit and ConfigurationChangeEvents) and posts each record to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration with the dataset name as the first key. Every record goes to CloudAudit with the technician, address, session type, status and description. The datasets identify machines by AgentId, not name. VSA 10 is a different product with its own entry (parsers/kaseya/vsa-10). Field names come from the Data Warehouse API reference (R95), which shows only placeholder values; the samples' values, including session types, statuses and log text, are made up. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (39 of 39 fields matched the emulator). No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
